landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: Rumble's Heat is walked over the fight's own cast plan (fight/rotation/cast_resource_lockout.py) instead of being asked for. The P slot states the cached rule and the shared timeline fills the bar cast by cast; reaching the ceiling empties it and silences every slot where that happens. The two scenario options (overheat_windows, overheat_autos) are retired, and so is self_cast_lockout_seconds, which took the lockout off the end of the horizon.
why: No fight NUMBER moves. Every diff is on Rumble's own declaration surface: the P row gains cast_resource_lockout, on_hit and stat_buff, and its detail string is rewritten. A golden sustained fight is ten seconds, and a ten-second Rumble reaches about 120 of the cached 150 Heat, so it Overheats zero times — which is what the retired option declared by default too.

The P row now carries on_hit and stat_buff unconditionally, because the count and the share they are worth are the fight's to decide. A fight that holds no window publishes no rider row at all, so a zero never reads as a priced slot.

The behaviour this buys is outside the golden's ten-second window: a no-item Rumble Overheats once in thirty seconds (four empowered swings) and twice with 65 ability haste (eight), and each lockout removes the casts it covers.

qualifying_population.rule: Rumble is the only kit that declares a cast_resource_lockout, so only Rumble's leaves qualify, and only the four on his level-11 passive row move.

/metadata/fingerprint/leaves.cause: the P row gains three declaration leaves and loses none
